exposure: Choriodecidual inoculation of weakly hemolytic group B Streptococcus strain
Choriodecidual inoculation of hyperhemolytic group B Streptococcus strain
outcome: Microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity
Amniotic fluid cytokines (IL-6, IL-8, TNF alpha, IL-1 beta)
Maternal plasma cytokines (TNF alpha, IL-1 beta, IL-6, IL-8)
Fetal plasma cytokines (TNF alpha, IL-1 beta, IL-6, IL-8)
cohort: The study participants were chronically catheterized pregnant pigtail macaques (Macaca nemestrina) at 116 to 125 days gestation.
finding: Amniotic fluid interleukin 6 and interleukin 8 levels were superior predictors of fetal lung injury compared with placental histopathology or maternal and fetal plasma cytokines.
